subject: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@retailco.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about RetailCo's use cases for product search re-ranking and the conversational agent for in-store associates. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Recommended initial models: Redwood-7B-quant (low latency, good for re-ranking), Redwood-13B-finetuned (higher quality for conversational follow-ups).
- I've attached the prompt set we used for the discovery evals (retailco_prompt_set_v1.json) and the benchmark outputs (eval_benchmarks_may2027.csv).
- Next steps: 1) Your team reviews the prompt set and highlights any domain-specific examples to add, 2) we run a scoped A/B with Redwood-7B-quant vs your current baseline for 2k queries, 3) plan rollback/pin policy if we see quality drift during model updates.

Can you confirm who on your side owns the prompt examples (Amit?) and whether we have permission to run the A/B on a 2k sample of live queries next week?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: retailco_prompt_set_v1.json, eval_benchmarks_may2027.csv

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@retailco.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — this is helpful. Amit owns the prompt examples; I looped him in. Two quick clarifications: 

1) For the A/B, we can surface a 2k sample but need to filter out PII and remove any orders data. I'll share filters.
2) On rollback/pinning: last month we saw a downgrade after an upstream model version bump; we need stronger guarantees or an option to pin until we've validated. What safeguards does Redwood provide today?

Amit, can you take a pass on the prompt file and annotate any examples to add?

Best,
Jenna
Director, Customer Experience | RetailCo
jenna.park@retailco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@retailco.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@retailco.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps

Jenna / Amit — great, thanks. A few notes and concrete proposals to address the rollback/pinning concern: 

- Safeguards we provide: pinning by model-version for specific routes, canary rollout windows (e.g., 1% -> 10% -> 100%), and automatic rollback triggers tied to a set of quality metrics. We also retain per-token diffs and sample outputs for quick triage.
- Proposed plan for the 2k A/B: Redwood runs the two model variants side-by-side and returns a side-by-side diff CSV (we've attached a recent model_diff_7b_v2_vs_v1.txt as an example). We'll also collect prompt-level metrics (accuracy, hallucination flags, latency).
- If you prefer, we can pin the conversational route to the current version during evaluation and only enable canary for a small % after you sign off.

Links:
- Shared Drive (prompt + evals): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-retailco-evals
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/9876

Next steps I propose this week:
1) Amit annotates the prompt set by EOD Tue (18 May).
2) We schedule the 2k A/B for Wed 19 May (can run dry-run on a synthetic sample first).
3) Michael will coordinate a short QA run and has offered to monitor the canary metrics.

Let me know if you'd prefer pin-first or canary-first. We're flexible.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@retailco.com>, Amit Rao <amit@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps

Quick internal note (looping customer): we ran a scheduled infra/model rollout this morning that bumped the default 7B variant to v2 in hosted staging. Preliminary smoke shows a 6% drop in "entity recall" on the retail prompt set vs v1, driven by a tokenization change and a subtle rank score difference. I attached the diff we generated (model_diff_7b_v2_vs_v1.txt).

Recommendation: pause any wider canary and pin the route to 7B-v1 until we complete the triage. If RetailCo wants, we can push a temporary pin and open a regression ticket with engineering.

Marissa — can you shadow the ticket with Jenna? I'll include logs and sample outputs in the ticket.

-Michael
VP, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Amit Rao <amit@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 21:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit & evals follow-up — benchmark links + next steps

Thanks for the heads up Michael and Marissa. Please pin the conversational route to 7B-v1 immediately and hold the A/B until we get confirmation the regression is understood. We'll review the diff and the sample outputs when you post the ticket.

Amit and I will finish annotations tomorrow and stand by for your ticket. We appreciate the quick response.

-Jenna
